headline: Starlink access in Ukraine returns to normal as Musk accuses Ukraine of misuse
summary: Musk reportedly ordered SpaceX to throttle Ukraine's Starlink access, which Musk and Trump initially denied before a WSJ report attributed the order to Musk. Starlink service in Ukraine has since returned to normal. Musk has now accused Ukraine of violating Starlink's terms by using the service for deadly drone strikes, which Ukraine denies, saying Starshield is back to normal.
